summary: Backend testing of data integrity features (duplicate warning, idempotency, task-gen transactional handling, retry-tasks). 5/6 pytest assertions PASSED. Found 1 critical bug: retry-tasks endpoint throws 500 due to missing organization_id argument in service call.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for ANY call (including non-existent id which should be 404). Root cause: router.py line 159 calls `assignment_service.get_assignment(assignment_id)` but the AssignmentService.get_assignment() signature requires `organization_id` as second positional argument. TypeError raised before the 404 check runs. Endpoint is entirely non-functional.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/modules/esg_assignments/router.py line 159: change to `assignment = await assignment_service.get_assignment(assignment_id, current_user['organization_id'])` OR switch to using assignment_service_v2.get_assignment (which only requires assignment_id) — pick whichever matches the intent. The subsequent org_id check on line 164 becomes redundant if using the org-scoped service call.
Consider returning 404 explicitly when assignment not found rather than 500.
critical_code_review_comments: router.py retry-tasks endpoint has broken get_assignment() call — never worked in production.

In check_idempotency (esg_records/router.py:54), cached response is mutated with `_idempotent=True` after fetch. Works but consider that store_idempotency stores the response dict INCLUDING the record object; if the record contains non-JSON-serializable objects (e.g., datetime), this could fail. Currently record dates are ISO strings so it works.

Duplicate check in service.py:311-315 uses $or on facility_id AND then reassigns $or on line 331 for reporting_type — this OVERWRITES the earlier $or clause, causing the facility_id null-check to be lost. Should use $and or combine conditions. Not currently causing test failures since facility_id was None in tests but could match wrong records in prod.
assignment_service_v2.py:411 stores `updated_at` as ISO string on task_generation_pending path but as datetime elsewhere — inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed environment records under Water/Withdrawal for year 2099 (Feb-May) to test duplicate warning and idempotency flows. Cleanup not automated — safe as year 2099 is outside any real reporting window.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 1 (duplicate warning) and Feature 2 (idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key returning _idempotent=true) are working correctly. Feature 3 (task_generation_pending flag) was not directly testable without simulating failure — could not reproduce. Feature 4 (retry-tasks endpoint) is BROKEN due to missing org_id arg. After main agent fixes router.py line 159, rerun the test file to verify 404 is returned for non-existent id.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/modules/esg_assignments/router.py line 159, `assignment_service.get_assignment(assignment_id)` is called with 1 arg, but AssignmentService.get_assignment(self, assignment_id, organization_id) requires 2. Reproduction: POST /api/esg-assignments/assignments/any-id/retry-tasks with admin token -> 500. Mitigation: pass current_user['organization_id'] or migrate this endpoint to use assignment_service_v2 which has a single-arg signature.
